item.title: Rabies Vaccine Warning: Doctors Say It Should Only Be Given in the Shoulder or Thigh - Never on the Buttocks
item.description: Rabies is nearly 100 per cent fatal once symptoms begin, but timely vaccination after an animal bite can prevent it. Doctors warn the rabies vaccine must be given in the shoulder or thigh - never the buttocks - as improper injection into fatty tissue can reduce effectiveness and require restarting the vaccination process.

item.title: Dipika Kakar Diagnosed with 13-mm Cyst, to Undergo Surgery Amid Cancer Battle
item.description: Television actress Dipika Kakar is set to undergo surgery to remove a 13-mm cyst amid her ongoing cancer battle. Doctors will assess biopsy results post-surgery to determine if immunotherapy is required. The procedure is considered a crucial step in her treatment plan, with fans and industry colleagues sending support as she continues her health journey.
